notes.title: Space Witch Pricing
notes.notes:
There's really no reason to do this except it's baller so check it - 

Space Witch 1 = $13
Space Witch 2 = $21
Space Witch 3D = $30
Space Witch 0 = $0

Space Witch 1 will be a single-player rogue-like tower defense, exploring the depths of solo play in two dimensions. 
[i]
NOTE: The Space Witch demo will be available forever! And contains almost the full game of Space Witch 1. Because I truly believe the best things in life are free!
NOTE 2: If you saw Space Witch tagged "free to play" it was meant to refer to the demo. I messed up the initial set up because I wanted to release the demo first, and got confused on how Steam does their demos.
NOTE 3: If you saw an announcement saying Space Witch 1 would cost $5, that was a typo from a previous economy. But then I remembered I make the rules and can discount it as much as I want! So this way I can offer premium prices and cheap discounts to make everybody happy! [/i]

Space Witch 2 will be similar but expand on the social elements, including adding multiplayer. I'd also like to go deep into NPC interactions, inspired by Dwarf Fortress and Baldur's Gate 3. Details TBD but it'll be cool, you can count on that!

Space Witch 3D will explore the universe from a new perspective! This will be like my Elden Ring where I really go big. How big will depend, we'll see. But y'know, my problem in life has always been being too much. Now I think I finally figured out how to make that less of a problem and more of an answer. Anyone who's enjoyed wandering around exploring Azeroth or the Lands Between should be excited to play this one. 

Space Witch Zero will be a prequel that ties it all together. The big finale, and a new beginning. And that one will be free, to make sure I pass the torch on to one who deserves it. Not just one who could afford it. But all y'all funding us along the way really helps a whole lot, we appreciate it greatly!
